مُقَصِّرٌ act. part. n. of 2, q. v. and see قَصَّارٌ. ―
-b2- [Deficient in liberality or bounty:] one who makes a gift scanty, or mean. (TA.) A poet says “فَقُلْتُ لَهُ قَدْ كُنْتَ فِيهَا مُقَصِّرًا
” [And I said to him Thou hast been deficient in liberality with respect to them; app. meaning she-camels or the like;] i. e., thou hast not given of them nor given to drink from them [of their milk]. (M.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
